body:
> **Re-scoped 2026-08-28 after decision (a) on #133.** The ledger is built from the transcript only;
> the hook counter is dropped. `session_id`/`transcript_path` are now stamped on every attempt
> (#135 at the verb, #137 from the tick), so the input exists.

## The problem

Workers run with `--permission-mode dontAsk`: an unlisted tool is denied, never prompted for. A denied
worker does not stop — it finds a workaround. Measured on this board: **208 native denials in 56 of 71
attempts**, zero of which ended the attempt; every worker routed around. Sometimes that is the whole
quality of the result — on pipao-v2 a worker denied the `react-aria` MCP server sitting in `.mcp.json`
built the components from training knowledge and said nothing.

## What to build

**1. A denied-tools ledger on the attempt row**, `denied_tools: [{tool, kind, count, first_seen}]`,
read from the transcript when the attempt ends (or at reap). Three native shapes land differently and
all three must be classified:
- `permission_denials` / `toolDenialKind: permission-rule` — a `--disallowedTools` rule;
- *"Permission to use <tool> has been denied because Claude Code is running in don't ask mode"* — an
  allowlist miss, a heredoc by shape, or `$(…)` substitution;
- the worktree guard's *"…can't be verified to stay inside the worktree"* — a tool **error**, absent
  from `permission_denials`; read tool results, not just the denials array.

**2. Surfaces.** `hkb show <n>` prints `denied: mcp__react-aria__* ×7, Skill ×2`. `hkb stats` adds a
board-wide line — *tools workers wanted and could not use*. The serve drawer shows it on the card.
`hkb doctor` turns the most-denied tool into the exact `allowed_tools` edit.

**3. Doctor checks the MCP servers reach a worker at all.** A `.mcp.json` server may never load in a
`--bg dontAsk` session; if the tool never appears, the ledger stays empty for the wrong reason. Verify
what a worker session sees and warn when repo MCP servers are invisible to workers.

(The "disclose, don't work around" instruction now ships as prompt text in the follow-up to #133.)

## Constraints

- Read the transcript once per attempt, locally, never over the network.
- Tool names verbatim. `--json` stable: `denied_tools` on the attempt, the aggregate in `hkb stats --json`.

## Done when

- An attempt refused a tool shows it in `hkb show`, the drawer and `hkb stats`, with the right `kind`.
- The worktree-guard shape is counted (a fixture transcript with that error, no `permission_denials`).
- `hkb doctor` proposes the allowlist edit and reports invisible `.mcp.json` servers.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green.
goal: a denied MCP/Skill/Agent/Bash attempt is visible on the attempt, the card and the board stats, with the config fix suggested
title: The board shows every tool a worker wanted and was refused, so the operator can grant it
